# Bundled vLLM-Omni runtime

This directory contains the vLLM-Omni v0.32.0 runtime source used by MonoWire.
It is tracked directly in the containing Git repository.

Follow the [MonoWire installation and usage guide](../../README.md). The source
revision, local modifications, and snapshot boundaries are documented in
[UPSTREAM.md](UPSTREAM.md); runtime versions are pinned in
[../../runtime.lock.json](../../runtime.lock.json).

The upstream project is [vLLM-Omni](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-omni).
For general upstream usage, see the
[official documentation](https://docs.vllm.ai/projects/vllm-omni/en/latest/).

This source retains the [Apache-2.0 license](LICENSE) and embedded third-party
copyright and license notices. MonoWire's MIT license does not replace them.
